title: Flying Dragon Flight Simulator
physics_constraints: base forward speed: 8 m/s along dragon facing direction
Space: +5 m/s upward, Shift: +5 m/s forward-down
ring pass detection: distance < 3.5 units from ring center
crash: y < 1 triggers reset to (0,20,0), -5 score
5 active rings at all times, regenerate on pass
difficulty_analysis: L5 challenges: (1) Loading the dragon model with GLTFLoader and playing the flying animation; (2) A custom 6DOF flight control system (pitch/yaw/acceleration/diving); (3) Ring checkpoint collision detection in 3D space; (4) A smooth third-person tracking camera; (5) Dynamic ring generation and disappearance effects; (6) Base forward speed + additive keyboard controls; (7) Ground-crash detection and reset; (8) Complete HUD state management
